Snow Leopard Scouting / Snow Leopard Spotting / Snow Leopard Trek / Snow Leopard Expedition to Ladakh. Winter Snow Leopard Tours to Ladakh

Snow Leopard is one of the most elusive big cats of the world and taking photograph and spotting them is once in a life time experience. Ancient Tracks, local Ladakh Travel Agent is specialized in operating Wildlife Tours in Ladakh in the winter months - from mid December till mid March every year. The tour involves high altitude treks and camping in Valleys in extreme cold temperature and demands high level of fitness of participants. Our team members are experienced in leading such tours and do their best in providing best possible services. These tours are conducted in popular snow leopard habitats like the Hemis National Park (HNP) also called the Hemis HIGH ALTITUDE National Park, Ulley, Saspotsey, Nubra, Changthang, Rong Valley, etc.. Few days of acclimatization before venturing on this trips are advisable and in our programs, we allow ample time for this preparations.

Ancient Tracks is a Travel Company based in Leh. Ancient Tracks specializes in Wildlife, Spiritual, Cultural and Educational tours to Ladakh Himalaya. Birding in Ladakh, Snow Leopard Tour in Ladakh, Pallas's Cat, Eurasian Lynx and Himalayan Brown Bear tours to Ladakh are some of the highlights of the only Wildlife Tour offering company in Ladakh.
